# Digiday

> > Digiday is a leading media and marketing publication covering digital advertising, social media strategy, ad-tech innovation, and the evolving media landscape.

Digiday provides news, analysis, and insights for marketing and media professionals navigating digital transformation. The site features industry interviews with executives from companies like PepsiCo and agencies like R/GA, explainers on emerging technologies, and coverage of key industry events including the Digiday Publishing Summit.

## Key Topics

- Social Media Marketing
- Ad-Tech & Programmatic Advertising
- Brand Engagement & Consumer Behavior
- Digital Marketing Strategy
- Content Distribution & Quality
- Video Advertising
- Media Buying & Planning
- Big Data Analytics
- Mobile Advertising
- Facebook & Twitter Platforms
- Agency Business Models
- Attention Economy
- Pixel Tracking & Analytics
- Demand-Side Platforms (DSP)
- Social Intelligence

## Social Media & Brand Strategy

- [PepsiCo's Shiv Singh on Competing for Attention in Social Media](https://digiday.com/media/pepsicos-shiv-singh-on-competing-for-attention-in-social-media): PepsiCo's Shiv Singh discusses social media strategy and attention economy
- [Converseon CEO Rob Key on Social Intelligence](https://digiday.com/media/converseon-ceo-rob-key-on-social-intelligence): Converseon CEO Rob Key on social intelligence and conversation mining
- [Brian Solis on How Brands Are Antisocial in Social Media](https://digiday.com/media/brian-solis-on-how-brands-are-antisocial-in-social-media): Altimeter's Brian Solis critiques antisocial brand behavior on social media
- [Infographic: Brands Are Not on the Same Page as Consumers](https://digiday.com/media/infographic-brands-are-not-on-the-same-page-as-consumers): IBM infographic shows brand-consumer disconnect in social media
- [Facebook Wants You to Share Your Story](https://digiday.com/media/facebook-wants-you-to-share-your-story): Facebook Timeline feature update and social sharing trends coverage
- [R/GA is Top Winner at SAMMY Awards](https://digiday.com/media/rga-is-top-winner-at-sammy-awards): R/GA wins top honors at SAMMY Awards for social media marketing
